comments: Agent1 is the initiator and ego is the responder (input facts). Assumptions: opposing straight approaches at a four-way intersection; an unmodeled perceived hazard triggers agent1 after 1 second to steer left across the centerline along a conflicting left-turn connector. The connector is a kinematic evasive-path surrogate, not a planned intersection turn. Ego follows its straight trajectory and brakes when agent1 enters a 16–20 m safety radius. Approach speeds are 7–9 m/s, initial partner separation 22–48 m. Opportunity for conflict is intended; collision is not required.
